The text has been translated into multiple languages, including an English translation by John Kelly [SuttaCentral].
No direct external parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora are listed by SuttaCentral or detected by DharmaNexus [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
